design_philosophy.concept: Swiss Architectural Editorial & Handcrafted Human Minimalism
anti_ai_directives: NO purple gradients on dark backgrounds (strictly forbidden). Use solid deep violet accent blocks, crisp stark borders, and warm paper/bone off-whites or solid midnight backgrounds.

NO repetitive Section Badge -> Big Title -> Subtitle -> 3-Card Grid formula. Break layouts with asymmetric editorial columns, magazine-style offset quotes, interactive live preview terminals, and horizontal split-screen reader layouts.
NO founder photo in the Story section. Replace with a handcrafted typographic manifesto card, handwritten signature accent, and timeline notes.
NO pricing tables, NO paid subscriptions, NO founding member tiers. Emphasize '100% Gratuit / 100% Free' loudly in hero and badges.

NO generic centered hero with badge + title + 2 buttons + floating icons. Use a bold asymmetric magazine cover layout with live interactive mini-widgets (Atlas AI snippet, Live Crypto Price Ticker, 3-Language News Switcher).
design_philosophy.theme: Light & Deep Contrast Mode with Warm Architectural Bone/Slate and Deep Violet (#4C1D95 / #6D28D9 / #7C3AED / #2E1065) used with surgical precision, not slop gradients.

typography.headline_font: Cabinet Grotesk or Clash Display or Syne (Primary display) paired with Instrument Serif or Cormorant Garamond for italic editorial accents
typography.body_font: Plus Jakarta Sans or General Sans or Inter (clean geometric body)
typography.mono_font: JetBrains Mono (for live market tickers and data metrics)

type_hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tight leading-[1.05]
type_hierarchy.h2: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight leading-tight
type_hierarchy.subtitle: text-lg sm:text-xl font-normal text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 max-w-2xl leading-relaxed
type_hierarchy.caption: text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-violet-700 dark:text-violet-300

key_features_to_build.name: Navigation Bar
key_features_to_build.details: Brand logo 'MENTOVA' with bold violet dot, language selector dropdown/tabs (FR / EN / ES), nav links (Features, Atlas AI, Marché, Actualités, Histoire, Roadmap, FAQ), 100% Free badge, and primary CTA 'Ouvrir l'App' pointing to app.mentova-academy.com.

key_features_to_build.name: Asymmetric Magazine Hero
key_features_to_build.details: Swiss grid layout. Left side: Massive typography ('L'Académie Crypto 100% Gratuite & Guidée par l'IA'), '100% GRATUIT • SANS ABONNEMENT' tag, interactive quick prompt box for Atlas AI, language indicator, CTA button 'Lancer Mentova (Gratuit)'. Right side: Live interactive interactive mockup showing Atlas AI answering a crypto question + live crypto ticker (BTC, ETH, SOL) + quick 3-language news snippet.

key_features_to_build.name: Atlas AI Mentor Interactive Playground
key_features_to_build.details: Showcase Atlas AI in action. User can click sample prompts ('C'est quoi le Halving Bitcoin ?', 'Explique-moi la DeFi en 3 phrases', 'Comment analyser un Whitepaper ?') and see instant conversational simulated responses in chosen language (FR/EN/ES). Highlight human voice, no jargon, personalized learning paths.

key_features_to_build.name: Live Market & Analytics Tracker
key_features_to_build.details: Clean tabular & chart interface previewing real-time market trends, sentiment index, volume indicators, and fear/greed meter. Pure readability, high contrast numbers, crisp borders.

key_features_to_build.name: Trilingual Crypto News Engine (FR / EN / ES)
key_features_to_build.details: Interactive newsfeed tabs where switching FR / EN / ES dynamically updates news headlines, AI summaries, and key takeaways in real-time. Explains why news in 3 languages gives global market advantage.

key_features_to_build.name: Handcrafted Founder Story (NO PHOTO)
key_features_to_build.details: Strictly NO founder photo. Designed like an editorial manifesto / open letter block. Title: 'Pourquoi Mentova existe (et restera 100% gratuit)'. Features a beautiful typography-first layout with quote marks, personal story breakdown, key commitments list, and an elegant digital handwritten signature graphic/typography.

key_features_to_build.name: Interactive Feature Roadmap
key_features_to_build.details: Timeline displaying Q1 2026 (Live Now: Atlas AI v2, Trilingual News, Market Tracker), Q2 2026 (On-Chain Alerts, Simulator), Q3 2026 (Community Hub & Mentorship). Status indicators: 'Disponible', 'En Développement', 'À Venir'.

key_features_to_build.name: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
key_features_to_build.details: Accordion items addressing 'Est-ce vraiment 100% gratuit ?', 'Comment fonctionne Atlas AI ?', 'Ai-je besoin de connaissances préalables ?', 'Comment accéder à l'application ?', 'Proposez-vous du conseil financier ? (Non, éducation uniquement)'.

key_features_to_build.name: Bold Minimalist Footer
key_features_to_build.details: Massive typography 'MENTOVA ACADEMY', quick navigation, language switcher, disclaimer ('Mentova est un outil éducatif...'), direct link to app.mentova-academy.com.

layout_and_component_rules.grid_strategy: Asymmetric Swiss grid with offset columns, generous 80px-120px section padding, crisp 1px subtle borders (border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800), and no repetitive card matrices.
layout_and_component_rules.buttons: Pill or crisp 8px rounded buttons with solid deep violet (#5B21B6 / #7C3AED) or stark dark background, crisp hover states, smooth micro-interactions. Direct link to 'https://app.mentova-academy.com'.
layout_and_component_rules.language_support: Full reactive state for FR, EN, ES. Clicking language tabs instantly updates all page copy dynamically so users can experience Mentova in French, English, or Spanish.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all interactive elements have explicit data-testid attributes.
Do NOT add any pricing section or subscription tiers — Mentova is 100% free.
Do NOT include any founder photo in the story section — use typographic manifesto styling with signature.
Ensure links to app.mentova-academy.com are prominent.
